name: Floral Charm - Inspired by Gucci Flora | Elegant Women's Perfume
description: Floral Charm, inspired by the elegant Gucci Flora, is the embodiment of femininity and grace. The fragrance opens with a burst of citrus notes, offering a fresh and uplifting experience. As it develops, a heart of jasmine, peony, and rose unfolds, giving the perfume its floral character. These delicate notes are balanced with soft musk and sandalwood at the base, creating a sophisticated, warm finish. With a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, Floral Charm provides an enduring scent that lasts throughout the day, making it perfect for any occasion. This fragrance is both refreshing and timeless, capturing the essence of modern elegance. Features Top Notes: Citrus, Fruity Notes Heart Notes: Jasmine, Peony, Rose Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood Longevity: 8-10 hours (Very Long-Lasting) Occasion: Ideal for everyday wear, special occasions, or evening events Why Choose Floral Charm? Inspired by the luxurious Gucci Flora Crafted with up to 50% perfume oil concentration for a high-quality fragrance A versatile fragrance that’s perfect for both casual and formal occasions Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir in Pakistan
